purpose: A store of background jobs that outlive the page that started them: one flight per key, one lane per workspace, never retried, failures kept as notices, and an unfinished-action record that survives a reload and is never run again.
namedChanges: the module-level store becomes `createBackgroundJobs(options)`, which returns the same functions over the same state; nothing runs at import (the source registered with the person hub and read the storage when the module loaded: the factory does both when it is called);
the import of the person hub reads from the package "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-principal-hub" instead of "./principalHub";
`JobKind` was the union of six names and is now `string`; the kinds the intent reader accepts, which were a literal list, are the required option `kinds`;
the storage key `INTENTS` (the source app's own name) is the required option `storageKey`;

`failText` (the sentences of a failed job, including its special cases) and `unfinishedText` (the "did not finish" line) were functions in the module and are the required options `failText` and `unfinishedText`; the function `failText` is no longer exported;
the message of a job cancelled before it started and the message of a job whose run threw were literal sentences and are the required options `cancelledText` and `crashText`;
the kind whose success leaves no toast (one literal kind name in `runOne`) is the option `quietSuccessKinds`, default none;
`cancelJobs(workspace, draftId, kinds)`: `kinds` had a default of two kind names and is now required;
new options with the source's values as defaults: `keepFinished` (40), `storage` (sessionStorage, or none), `cacheNames` ("backgroundJobs", "backgroundJobIntents");
the placeholder entry that `exclusive` makes for a part of a job has kind "" instead of "queue" (it is never listed or shown);
the header comment loses its cycle tags and the source app's words. Job fields, the intent record's fields (`draftId` included) and every other behaviour are unchanged.

host.replaces: the six kind names, as a type and as the runtime list the intent reader checks
the function `unfinishedText` and its two sentences
the sentence of a cancelled job
the sentence of a job whose run threw
the literal check that the kind "pick" leaves no toast
